value.rationale: The open structural issue after eventual quasipolynomiality is the attainable least period and variation of leading terms even for polygons of minimum centrally symmetric combinatorial complexity. This infinite primitive-edged four-vertex family realizes every m>=2 as exact least eventual period and has all m leading slopes distinct with largest/smallest ratio m. This is a parameter-unbounded statement not supplied by the source period-three example or general existence theorem, with explicit reproducible formulas at every dilation.
